description: AISSEE Class 6 pattern: English 25, Mathematics 50, Intelligence 25 and General Knowledge 25 questions (125 questions, 300 marks, 150 minutes). Original practice paper on the 2023 pattern (not the official paper). Free.

questions.text: According to the passage, the Thar Desert lies mostly in:
questions.explanation: The first sentence says it lies "mostly in Rajasthan".
questions.passage: The Thar Desert lies in the north-western part of India, mostly in Rajasthan. It is also called the Great Indian Desert. In summer, the sand becomes so hot that people cannot walk on it without shoes. At night, however, the desert can become quite cold. There is very little rain here, so water is precious. Villagers store rainwater in deep tanks and wells and use every drop carefully. The camel is the most useful animal of the desert. It can walk for days without drinking water, and its wide, padded feet do not sink in the soft sand. That is why it is called the "ship of the desert". The people of the desert wear bright, colourful clothes, and the men often wear turbans that protect their heads from the sun. Jaisalmer, a city built of yellow stone, stands in the heart of the Thar. Every winter, visitors come to enjoy camel rides, folk music and the golden sand dunes under the starry sky.

questions.text: Why is the camel called the "ship of the desert"?
options: It carries boats on its back
It can cross the sand for days without drinking water
questions.explanation: The camel can walk for days without water and its wide feet do not sink, so it "sails" across the sand.

questions.text: Choose the word that means the SAME as "rapid".
questions.explanation: "Rapid" means fast or quick.

questions.text: Choose the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to "generous".
questions.explanation: A generous person shares freely; a selfish person thinks only of himself.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: There is only one sun, so we use "the".

questions.text: Fill in the blank: She has been ill ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: "Since" is used with a point of time (Monday); "for" is used with a period of time (three days).

questions.text: What is the plural of "mouse"?
questions.explanation: "Mouse" has an irregular plural: "mice".

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: Necessary has one "c" and double "s": N-E-C-E-S-S-A-R-Y.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Look! The children ___ in the park.
questions.explanation: "Look!" shows the action is happening now, so we use the present continuous "are playing".

questions.text: One word for "a place where animals are kept for people to see" is:
questions.explanation: A zoo keeps animals for the public to see.

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct collective noun: a ___ of cows
questions.explanation: We say a herd of cows, a flock of sheep, a swarm of bees and a pack of wolves.

questions.text: What is the masculine of "duck"?
questions.explanation: A male duck is a drake. (A gander is a male goose.)

questions.text: Which word is a VERB in the sentence: "The baby sleeps peacefully."
questions.explanation: "Sleeps" tells the action, so it is the verb.

questions.text: Which word is an ADVERB in the sentence: "The old man walked slowly."
questions.explanation: "Slowly" tells how the man walked, so it is an adverb.

questions.text: The idiom "to break the ice" means:
options: to start talking in a shy or silent situation
to break a block of ice
questions.explanation: To break the ice is to start a conversation and make people feel comfortable.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: This is the ___ book I have ever read.
questions.explanation: When comparing with all others we use the superlative "best".

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Each of the boys have a bat.
Each of the boy has a bat.
Each of the boys has a bat.
Each of the boys having a bat.
questions.explanation: "Each" is singular, so it takes "has", and "of the" is followed by the plural "boys".

questions.text: Choose the OPPOSITE of "arrive".
questions.explanation: To arrive is to reach a place; to depart is to leave it.

questions.text: Change into a question: "Rahul lives in Pune."
questions.explanation: For simple present with "he/she", we use "does" + base verb: "Where does Rahul live?"

questions.text: Fill in the blank: I can ___ the school bell ringing.
questions.explanation: "Hear" means to listen with the ears. "Here" means in this place.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Neither Ram nor Shyam ___ present yesterday.
questions.explanation: With "neither … nor" joining two singular nouns, the verb is singular; "yesterday" needs the past "was".

questions.text: Choose the correct opposite of "possible" formed with a prefix.
questions.explanation: The prefix "im-" is used: possible → impossible.

questions.text: What is the ratio 48 : 64 in its simplest form?
questions.textHi: 48 : 64 का सरलतम रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: Divide both by the HCF 16: 48 ÷ 16 = 3, 64 ÷ 16 = 4.

questions.text: ₹720 is divided between Asha and Bina in the ratio 4 : 5. What is Bina's share?
questions.textHi: ₹720 को आशा और बीना में 4 : 5 के अनुपात में बाँटा गया। बीना का हिस्सा कितना है?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 9. One part = 720 ÷ 9 = ₹80. Bina gets 5 × 80 = ₹400.

questions.text: If a : b = 2 : 3 and b : c = 4 : 5, what is a : c?
questions.textHi: यदि a : b = 2 : 3 और b : c = 4 : 5 हो, तो a : c क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Make b equal: a : b = 8 : 12 and b : c = 12 : 15. So a : c = 8 : 15.
questions.explanationHi: b को बराबर करें: a : b = 8 : 12 और b : c = 12 : 15। अतः a : c = 8 : 15।

questions.text: If 3 : x = 12 : 20, find x.
questions.textHi: यदि 3 : x = 12 : 20 हो, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: 12 : 20 = 3 : 5 (dividing by 4), so x = 5.

questions.text: In a class of 40 students, the ratio of boys to girls is 5 : 3. How many girls are there?
questions.textHi: 40 विद्यार्थियों की एक कक्षा में लड़कों और लड़कियों का अनुपात 5 : 3 है। लड़कियाँ कितनी हैं?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 8. One part = 40 ÷ 8 = 5. Girls = 3 × 5 = 15.

questions.text: A toy bought for ₹800 is sold for ₹920. What is the profit per cent?
questions.textHi: ₹800 में खरीदा गया खिलौना ₹920 में बेचा गया। लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?

questions.text: A watch costing ₹1,500 is sold at a loss of 10%. What is its selling price?
questions.textHi: ₹1,500 की घड़ी 10% हानि पर बेची गई। उसका विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?

questions.text: The selling price of 10 pencils equals the cost price of 12 pencils. What is the profit per cent?
questions.textHi: 10 पेंसिलों का विक्रय मूल्य 12 पेंसिलों के क्रय मूल्य के बराबर है। लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?
questions.explanation: Let one pencil cost ₹1. 10 pencils are sold for ₹12, so profit on ₹10 is ₹2, which is 20%.

questions.text: A shopkeeper buys 20 kg of rice at ₹45 per kg and sells it at ₹52 per kg. What is his total profit?
questions.textHi: एक दुकानदार 20 किग्रा चावल ₹45 प्रति किग्रा पर खरीदकर ₹52 प्रति किग्रा पर बेचता है। उसका कुल लाभ कितना है?
questions.explanation: Profit per kg = 52 − 45 = ₹7. Total profit = 7 × 20 = ₹140.

questions.text: By selling a bag for ₹660, a shopkeeper gains 10%. What was the cost price of the bag?
questions.textHi: एक बैग ₹660 में बेचने पर दुकानदार को 10% लाभ होता है। बैग का क्रय मूल्य क्या था?

questions.text: What is the volume of a cuboid 10 cm long, 8 cm wide and 5 cm high?
questions.textHi: 10 सेमी लंबे, 8 सेमी चौड़े और 5 सेमी ऊँचे घनाभ का आयतन कितना है?
questions.explanation: Volume = l × b × h = 10 × 8 × 5 = 400 cu cm.

questions.text: The volume of a cube is 125 cu cm. What is the length of its edge?
questions.textHi: एक घन का आयतन 125 घन सेमी है। उसके किनारे की लंबाई कितनी है?
questions.explanation: 5 × 5 × 5 = 125, so the edge is 5 cm.

questions.text: How many cubes of edge 2 cm can be packed in a box 8 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm?
questions.textHi: 8 सेमी × 6 सेमी × 4 सेमी के डिब्बे में 2 सेमी किनारे वाले कितने घन रखे जा सकते हैं?
questions.explanation: Along each side: 8 ÷ 2 = 4, 6 ÷ 2 = 3, 4 ÷ 2 = 2. Number of cubes = 4 × 3 × 2 = 24.

questions.text: A water tank is 2 m long, 1.5 m wide and 1 m deep. How many litres of water can it hold? (1 cubic metre = 1000 litres)
questions.textHi: एक पानी की टंकी 2 मीटर लंबी, 1.5 मीटर चौड़ी और 1 मीटर गहरी है। उसमें कितने लीटर पानी आ सकता है? (1 घन मीटर = 1000 लीटर)
questions.explanation: Volume = 2 × 1.5 × 1 = 3 cubic metres = 3 × 1000 = 3,000 litres.

questions.text: If the edge of a cube is doubled, its volume becomes how many times?
questions.textHi: यदि किसी घन का किनारा दुगुना कर दिया जाए, तो उसका आयतन कितने गुना हो जाएगा?
questions.explanation: New volume = 2a × 2a × 2a = 8 × a × a × a, so 8 times.
questions.explanationHi: नया आयतन = 2a × 2a × 2a = 8 × a × a × a, अतः 8 गुना।

questions.text: 1 litre is equal to:
questions.textHi: 1 लीटर किसके बराबर है?
questions.explanation: 1 litre = 1000 millilitres = 1000 cubic centimetres.

questions.text: What is the HCF of 18, 27 and 45?
questions.textHi: 18, 27 और 45 का HCF क्या है?

questions.text: What is the LCM of 15 and 20?
questions.textHi: 15 और 20 का LCM क्या है?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 20: 20, 40, 60… 60 is the first one divisible by 15.
With denominator 6: 3/6 + 2/6 + 1/6 = 6/6 = 1.

questions.text: What is 3/7 of 210?

questions.explanation: Multiply both by 100: 120 ÷ 4 = 30.

questions.text: What is the simple interest on ₹2,400 at 5% per year for 2 years?
questions.textHi: ₹2,400 पर 5% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज कितना होगा?

questions.text: At what rate per cent per year will ₹2,500 earn ₹600 as simple interest in 3 years?
questions.textHi: किस वार्षिक दर से ₹2,500 पर 3 वर्ष में ₹600 साधारण ब्याज मिलेगा?

questions.text: 18 is what per cent of 72?
questions.textHi: 18, 72 का कितना प्रतिशत है?

questions.text: The price of a book rises from ₹80 to ₹100. What is the percentage increase?
questions.textHi: एक किताब का मूल्य ₹80 से बढ़कर ₹100 हो गया। प्रतिशत वृद्धि कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Increase = ₹20. Increase % = 20/80 × 100 = 25%. (Always divide by the old price.)

questions.text: What is the average of the first 10 natural numbers?
questions.textHi: पहली 10 प्राकृत संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?

questions.text: The average of 5 numbers is 40. When one number is removed, the average of the other 4 is 38. Which number was removed?
questions.textHi: 5 संख्याओं का औसत 40 है। एक संख्या हटाने पर शेष 4 का औसत 38 हो जाता है। हटाई गई संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: Total of 5 = 5 × 40 = 200. Total of 4 = 4 × 38 = 152. Removed number = 200 − 152 = 48.

questions.text: A car moves at 60 km/h. How far will it go in 2 hours 30 minutes?
questions.textHi: एक कार 60 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चलती है। वह 2 घंटे 30 मिनट में कितनी दूरी तय करेगी?
questions.explanation: Distance = speed × time = 60 × 2.5 = 150 km.

questions.text: A train 200 m long runs at 72 km/h. How long will it take to pass a pole?
questions.textHi: 200 मीटर लंबी एक रेलगाड़ी 72 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। एक खंभे को पार करने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?

questions.text: 8 workers can build a wall in 15 days. How many days will 12 workers take to build the same wall?
questions.textHi: 8 मज़दूर एक दीवार 15 दिन में बनाते हैं। 12 मज़दूर वही दीवार कितने दिन में बनाएँगे?
questions.explanation: Work = 8 × 15 = 120 worker-days. 12 workers need 120 ÷ 12 = 10 days.

questions.text: 5 kg of sugar costs ₹215. What is the cost of 3 kg of sugar?
questions.textHi: 5 किग्रा चीनी का मूल्य ₹215 है। 3 किग्रा चीनी का मूल्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: 1 kg costs 215 ÷ 5 = ₹43, so 3 kg cost 3 × 43 = ₹129.

questions.text: Which is the smallest prime number?
questions.textHi: सबसे छोटी अभाज्य संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: 2 has exactly two factors (1 and 2). 1 is neither prime nor composite.
questions.explanationHi: 2 के ठीक दो गुणनखंड (1 और 2) हैं। 1 न अभाज्य है न भाज्य।

questions.text: What is the sum of all prime numbers less than 15?
questions.textHi: 15 से छोटी सभी अभाज्य संख्याओं का योग क्या है?

questions.text: What is the value of the Roman numeral CDXC?
questions.textHi: रोमन अंक CDXC का मान क्या है?
questions.explanation: CD = 400 and XC = 90, so CDXC = 490.

questions.text: How is the year 2023 written in Roman numerals?
questions.textHi: वर्ष 2023 को रोमन अंकों में कैसे लिखते हैं?
questions.explanation: MM = 2000, XX = 20, III = 3. So 2023 = MMXXIII.

questions.text: What is the difference between the place value and the face value of 6 in 36,428?
questions.textHi: 36,428 में 6 के स्थानीय मान और जातीय (अंकित) मान का अंतर कितना है?
questions.explanation: Place value = 6,000 and face value = 6. Difference = 6000 − 6 = 5,994.

questions.text: What is the smallest 5-digit number that can be made using each of the digits 3, 0, 7, 1, 9 once?
questions.textHi: अंकों 3, 0, 7, 1, 9 को एक-एक बार प्रयोग करके बनने वाली सबसे छोटी 5-अंकीय संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: The first digit cannot be 0, so start with 1, then put 0, 3, 7, 9 in increasing order: 10,379.
questions.explanationHi: पहला अंक 0 नहीं हो सकता, इसलिए 1 से शुरू करें, फिर 0, 3, 7, 9 बढ़ते क्रम में: 10,379।

questions.text: Simplify: 25 − 5 × 4 + 18 ÷ 3
What is the supplement of 72°?
questions.textHi: 72° का संपूरक कोण कितना है?
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles add up to 180°: 180° − 72° = 108°.

questions.text: Two angles of a triangle are 50° and 60°. What is the third angle?
questions.textHi: एक त्रिभुज के दो कोण 50° और 60° हैं। तीसरा कोण कितना है?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°: 180° − (50° + 60°) = 70°.

questions.text: Which of these is a reflex angle?
questions.textHi: इनमें से वृहत् (प्रतिवर्ती) कोण कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: A reflex angle is more than 180° and less than 360°. Only 200° fits.
questions.explanationHi: वृहत् कोण 180° से अधिक और 360° से कम होता है। केवल 200° सही है।

questions.text: What is the area of a circle of diameter 28 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.textHi: 28 सेमी व्यास वाले वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल कितना है? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Radius = 14 cm. Area = πr² = 22/7 × 14 × 14 = 616 sq cm.

questions.text: A rectangular garden 18 m long and 12 m wide is fenced with 3 rounds of wire. How much wire is needed?
questions.textHi: 18 मीटर लंबे और 12 मीटर चौड़े आयताकार बगीचे के चारों ओर तार के 3 चक्कर लगाए जाते हैं। कितना तार लगेगा?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2 × (18 + 12) = 60 m. Three rounds = 3 × 60 = 180 m.

questions.text: 4 hours 15 minutes is equal to how many minutes?
questions.textHi: 4 घंटे 15 मिनट कितने मिनट के बराबर है?
questions.explanation: 4 × 60 = 240 minutes, and 240 + 15 = 255 minutes.

questions.text: 2.5 litres + 750 millilitres = ?
A child has a temperature of 104°F. What is this in degrees Celsius? (C = (F − 32) × 5/9)
questions.textHi: एक बच्चे का तापमान 104°F है। यह कितने डिग्री सेल्सियस होगा? (C = (F − 32) × 5/9)

questions.text: How many days are there from 15 March to 10 April, counting both days?
questions.textHi: 15 मार्च से 10 अप्रैल तक (दोनों दिन मिलाकर) कितने दिन होते हैं?
questions.explanation: March 15 to 31 = 17 days, April 1 to 10 = 10 days. Total = 27 days.

questions.text: Bananas are sold at ₹4 each. What is the cost of 6 dozen bananas?
questions.textHi: केले ₹4 प्रति केला बिकते हैं। 6 दर्जन केलों का मूल्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: 6 dozen = 6 × 12 = 72 bananas. Cost = 72 × 4 = ₹288.

questions.text: How many diagonals does a pentagon have?
questions.textHi: एक पंचभुज में कितने विकर्ण होते हैं?
questions.explanation: From each of the 5 corners, 2 diagonals can be drawn: 5 × 2 = 10, but each is counted twice, so 10 ÷ 2 = 5.
questions.explanationHi: 5 कोनों में से हर कोने से 2 विकर्ण: 5 × 2 = 10, पर हर विकर्ण दो बार गिना गया, अतः 10 ÷ 2 = 5।

questions.text: Bird : Nest :: Bee : ?
questions.textHi: पक्षी : घोंसला :: मधुमक्खी : ?
questions.explanation: A bird lives in a nest; a bee lives in a hive.
questions.explanationHi: पक्षी घोंसले में रहता है; मधुमक्खी छत्ते में।

questions.text: Select the figure which is different from the others.
questions.textHi: उस आकृति को चुनिए जो अन्य से भिन्न है।
questions.explanation: In (B), (C) and (D) the small inner shape is the same as the big outer shape. In (A) a circle is inside a square.
questions.explanationHi: (B), (C) और (D) में भीतर की छोटी आकृति बाहर की बड़ी आकृति जैसी ही है। (A) में वर्ग के अंदर वृत्त है।

questions.textHi: लुप्त पद ज्ञात कीजिए: 3 : 27 :: 5 : ?
questions.explanation: 27 = 3 × 3 × 3, so the answer is 5 × 5 × 5 = 125.

questions.text: AC : BD :: PR : ?
questions.textHi: लुप्त पद ज्ञात कीजिए: AC : BD :: PR : ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one step forward: A→B, C→D. So P→Q, R→S.
questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर एक स्थान आगे: A→B, C→D। इसलिए P→Q, R→S।

questions.text: Find the odd one out.
questions.textHi: भिन्न को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Mercury, Venus and Mars are planets; the Moon is a satellite.
questions.explanationHi: बुध, शुक्र और मंगल ग्रह हैं; चंद्रमा उपग्रह है।

questions.text: Find the odd number out.
questions.textHi: भिन्न संख्या को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: 9, 25 and 49 are perfect squares (3², 5², 7²); 63 is not.

questions.text: Which figure comes next in the series?
questions.textHi: श्रृंखला में अगली आकृति कौन-सी होगी?
questions.explanation: At every step the arrow turns 90° clockwise and one more dot is added. After (left, 4 dots) comes (up, 5 dots).
questions.explanationHi: हर चरण में तीर 90° दक्षिणावर्त घूमता है और एक बिंदु बढ़ता है। (बाएँ, 4 बिंदु) के बाद (ऊपर, 5 बिंदु) आएगा।

questions.text: Find the next number: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is doubled: 40 × 2 = 80.

questions.text: Find the next number: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.explanation: The differences are 3, 5, 7, 9, so next is 11: 26 + 11 = 37.

questions.text: Find the next letter: Z, X, V, T, ?
questions.textHi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: Z, X, V, T, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter goes 2 steps back: T − 2 = R.
questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर 2 स्थान पीछे जाता है: T − 2 = R।

questions.text: Select the figure that completes the analogy.
questions.textHi: वह आकृति चुनिए जो सादृश्य को पूरा करती है।
questions.explanation: The second figure is the first figure turned 90° clockwise. So the L-shape with the dot must also turn 90° clockwise: long arm along the top, short arm down on the left.
questions.explanationHi: दूसरी आकृति पहली आकृति को 90° दक्षिणावर्त घुमाने से बनी है। इसलिए बिंदु वाली L-आकृति को भी 90° दक्षिणावर्त घुमाएँ: लंबी भुजा ऊपर, छोटी भुजा बाईं ओर नीचे।

questions.text: If ROSE is written as ESOR, how is LILY written in that code?
questions.textHi: यदि ROSE को ESOR लिखा जाता है, तो LILY को उसी कूट में कैसे लिखेंगे?
questions.explanation: The word is written in reverse order: LILY → YLIL.
questions.explanationHi: शब्द को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा गया है: LILY → YLIL।

questions.text: If FISH is coded as EHRG, how is BIRD coded?
questions.textHi: यदि FISH को EHRG लिखा जाता है, तो BIRD को कैसे लिखेंगे?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one step back: B→A, I→H, R→Q, D→C.
questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर एक स्थान पीछे जाता है: B→A, I→H, R→Q, D→C।

questions.text: Meena walks 10 m south, turns left and walks 6 m, then turns left again and walks 10 m. Where is she now from her starting point?
questions.textHi: मीना 10 मीटर दक्षिण चलती है, बाएँ मुड़कर 6 मीटर चलती है, फिर बाएँ मुड़कर 10 मीटर चलती है। अब वह अपने आरंभिक स्थान से कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: Facing south, a left turn means east; another left turn means north. South 10 and north 10 cancel, so she is 6 m east.
questions.explanationHi: दक्षिण की ओर मुँह करके बाएँ मुड़ने पर पूर्व, फिर बाएँ मुड़ने पर उत्तर। दक्षिण 10 और उत्तर 10 बराबर हो गए, इसलिए वह 6 मीटर पूर्व में है।

questions.text: Choose the correct water image of the problem figure (water line below the figure).
questions.textHi: प्रश्न आकृति का सही जल प्रतिबिंब चुनिए (जल रेखा आकृति के नीचे है)।
questions.explanation: In a water image, top and bottom swap but left and right stay the same. The black triangle goes to the bottom-right and the corner of the L goes to the top-left.
questions.explanationHi: जल प्रतिबिंब में ऊपर-नीचे बदल जाता है, पर बायाँ-दायाँ वही रहता है। काला त्रिभुज नीचे दाईं ओर और L का कोना ऊपर बाईं ओर चला जाता है।

questions.text: In the morning, Ankit stands facing the rising sun. In which direction will his shadow fall?
questions.textHi: सुबह अंकित उगते सूरज की ओर मुँह करके खड़ा है। उसकी परछाईं किस दिशा में पड़ेगी?
questions.explanation: The sun rises in the east, so the shadow falls on the opposite side, the west.
questions.explanationHi: सूरज पूर्व में उगता है, इसलिए परछाईं उल्टी ओर, पश्चिम में पड़ेगी।

questions.text: A man said to a girl, "Your mother is my mother's only daughter." How is the man related to the girl?
questions.textHi: एक आदमी ने एक लड़की से कहा, "तुम्हारी माँ मेरी माँ की इकलौती बेटी है।" वह आदमी लड़की का क्या लगता है?
questions.explanation: His mother's only daughter is his sister. So the girl's mother is his sister, and he is the girl's maternal uncle.
questions.explanationHi: उसकी माँ की इकलौती बेटी उसकी बहन है। लड़की की माँ उसकी बहन है, अतः वह लड़की का मामा है।

questions.text: Sita is the daughter of Ram's brother. How is Sita related to Ram?
questions.textHi: सीता, राम के भाई की बेटी है। सीता का राम से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A brother's daughter is a niece.
questions.explanationHi: भाई की बेटी भतीजी होती है।

questions.text: How many squares are there in the figure?
questions.textHi: आकृति में कितने वर्ग हैं?
questions.explanation: There are 6 small squares and 2 bigger squares, each made of 4 small squares. Total = 8.
questions.explanationHi: 6 छोटे वर्ग और 4-4 छोटे वर्गों से बने 2 बड़े वर्ग हैं। कुल = 8।

questions.text: Find the missing number: 8, 27, 64, ?, 216
questions.explanation: These are cubes: 2³, 3³, 4³, 5³, 6³. 5³ = 125.

questions.text: Vikas is 9th from the top and 16th from the bottom in his class. How many students are in the class?
questions.textHi: विकास अपनी कक्षा में ऊपर से 9वें और नीचे से 16वें स्थान पर है। कक्षा में कितने विद्यार्थी हैं?
questions.explanation: Total = 9 + 16 − 1 = 24 (Vikas is counted twice).

questions.text: A square sheet of paper is folded and punched as shown. How will it look when unfolded?
questions.textHi: कागज़ की एक वर्गाकार शीट को दिखाए अनुसार मोड़कर छेद किया गया है। खोलने पर वह कैसी दिखेगी?
questions.explanation: The left half was folded onto the right half, so the hole goes through both layers. On opening, there is a second hole at the same height on the left half, like a mirror image across the fold.
questions.explanationHi: बायाँ आधा भाग दाएँ आधे पर मोड़ा गया, इसलिए छेद दोनों परतों में हुआ। खोलने पर बाएँ आधे भाग में उसी ऊँचाई पर दूसरा छेद होगा, मोड़ की रेखा के दर्पण प्रतिबिंब की तरह।

questions.text: If 1 January of a year (not a leap year) is a Sunday, what day is 1 February?
questions.textHi: यदि किसी वर्ष (लीप वर्ष नहीं) की 1 जनवरी को रविवार है, तो 1 फ़रवरी को कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: January has 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. Sunday + 3 days = Wednesday.
questions.explanationHi: जनवरी में 31 दिन = 4 सप्ताह + 3 दिन। रविवार + 3 दिन = बुधवार।

questions.text: A clock shows 4:00. What time will its mirror image show?
questions.textHi: एक घड़ी में 4:00 बजे हैं। उसके दर्पण प्रतिबिंब में कितना समय दिखेगा?
questions.explanation: Mirror time = 12:00 − actual time = 12:00 − 4:00 = 8:00.

questions.text: If "×" means "+", "+" means "−", "−" means "÷" and "÷" means "×", find the value of 12 × 6 − 3 + 2 ÷ 4.
questions.explanation: After changing the signs: 12 + 6 ÷ 3 − 2 × 4 = 12 + 2 − 8 = 6.

questions.text: Which is the largest planet of our solar system?
questions.textHi: हमारे सौरमंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the biggest planet; more than 1,000 Earths could fit inside it.
questions.explanationHi: बृहस्पति सबसे बड़ा ग्रह है; इसमें 1,000 से अधिक पृथ्वियाँ समा सकती हैं।

questions.text: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.textHi: सूर्य के सबसे निकट कौन-सा ग्रह है?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the first planet from the Sun.
questions.explanationHi: बुध सूर्य से पहला ग्रह है।

questions.text: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.textHi: किस ग्रह को "लाल ग्रह" कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide (rust) in its soil makes Mars look red.
questions.explanationHi: मिट्टी में लौह ऑक्साइड (ज़ंग) के कारण मंगल लाल दिखता है।

questions.text: Which is the hottest planet of our solar system?
questions.textHi: हमारे सौरमंडल का सबसे गर्म ग्रह कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Venus has a thick blanket of carbon dioxide that traps heat, making it hotter than Mercury.
questions.explanationHi: शुक्र का कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड का घना वायुमंडल गर्मी रोक लेता है, इसलिए यह बुध से भी गर्म है।

questions.text: Which planet is famous for its bright, beautiful rings?
questions.textHi: कौन-सा ग्रह अपने चमकीले, सुंदर वलयों (छल्लों) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Saturn's rings, made of ice and rock, are the brightest in the solar system.
questions.explanationHi: बर्फ़ और चट्टानों से बने शनि के वलय सौरमंडल में सबसे चमकीले हैं।

questions.text: The Sun is a:
questions.textHi: सूर्य क्या है?
questions.explanation: The Sun is a star: a huge ball of hot gases that gives out its own light.
questions.explanationHi: सूर्य एक तारा है: गर्म गैसों का विशाल गोला जो अपना प्रकाश देता है।

questions.text: About how long does sunlight take to reach the Earth?
questions.textHi: सूर्य के प्रकाश को पृथ्वी तक पहुँचने में लगभग कितना समय लगता है?
questions.explanation: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach the Earth.
questions.explanationHi: सूर्य के प्रकाश को पृथ्वी तक आने में लगभग 8 मिनट 20 सेकंड लगते हैं।

questions.text: In August 2023, India's Chandrayaan-3 landed on the Moon near its:
questions.textHi: अगस्त 2023 में भारत का चंद्रयान-3 चंद्रमा पर किस भाग के पास उतरा?
questions.explanation: On 23 August 2023, Chandrayaan-3 made India the first country to land near the Moon's south pole.
questions.explanationHi: 23 अगस्त 2023 को चंद्रयान-3 के साथ भारत चंद्रमा के दक्षिणी ध्रुव के पास उतरने वाला पहला देश बना।

questions.text: How many states are there in India (as of 2024)?
questions.textHi: भारत में कितने राज्य हैं (2024 की स्थिति के अनुसार)?
questions.explanation: India has 28 states and 8 union territories.
questions.explanationHi: भारत में 28 राज्य और 8 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश हैं।

questions.text: Which is the largest state of India by area?
questions.textHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे बड़ा राज्य कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state by area.
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल में राजस्थान सबसे बड़ा राज्य है।

questions.text: What is the capital of Kerala?
questions.textHi: केरल की राजधानी क्या है?
questions.explanation: Thiruvananthapuram is the capital of Kerala.

questions.text: What is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.textHi: अरुणाचल प्रदेश की राजधानी क्या है?
questions.explanation: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh. (Shillong – Meghalaya, Kohima – Nagaland, Aizawl – Mizoram.)
questions.explanationHi: ईटानगर अरुणाचल प्रदेश की राजधानी है। (शिलांग – मेघालय, कोहिमा – नागालैंड, आइज़ोल – मिज़ोरम।)

questions.text: Which is the smallest state of India by area?
questions.textHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे छोटा राज्य कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest state by area.
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल में गोवा सबसे छोटा राज्य है।

questions.text: Which state is known as the "Land of Five Rivers"?
questions.textHi: किस राज्य को "पाँच नदियों की धरती" कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: "Punjab" means "five waters" (panj = five, aab = water).
questions.explanationHi: "पंजाब" का अर्थ है "पाँच पानी" (पंज = पाँच, आब = पानी)।

questions.text: Which is the newest state of India, formed in 2014?
questions.textHi: भारत का सबसे नया राज्य कौन-सा है, जो 2014 में बना?
questions.explanation: Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014. Jharkhand, Uttarakhand and Chhattisgarh were formed in 2000.
questions.explanationHi: तेलंगाना 2 जून 2014 को बना। झारखंड, उत्तराखंड और छत्तीसगढ़ 2000 में बने थे।

questions.text: Bihu is a famous festival of which state?
questions.textHi: बिहू किस राज्य का प्रसिद्ध त्योहार है?
questions.explanation: Bihu is the harvest festival of Assam.
questions.explanationHi: बिहू असम का फ़सल उत्सव है।

questions.text: The Garba dance is mainly associated with which state?
questions.textHi: गरबा नृत्य मुख्य रूप से किस राज्य से जुड़ा है?
questions.explanation: Garba is a folk dance of Gujarat, performed during Navratri.
questions.explanationHi: गरबा गुजरात का लोक नृत्य है, जो नवरात्रि में किया जाता है।

questions.text: Which organ of the human body pumps blood?
questions.textHi: मानव शरीर का कौन-सा अंग रक्त पंप करता है?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood to all parts of the body.
questions.explanationHi: हृदय शरीर के सभी भागों में रक्त पंप करता है।

questions.text: At sea level, pure water boils at:
questions.textHi: समुद्र तल पर शुद्ध पानी किस तापमान पर उबलता है?
questions.explanation: Pure water boils at 100°C (which is 212°F, not 212°C).
questions.explanationHi: शुद्ध पानी 100°C पर उबलता है (यह 212°F है, 212°C नहीं)।

questions.text: The Indian Military Academy (IMA), which trains Army officers, is located at:
questions.textHi: सेना के अधिकारियों को प्रशिक्षण देने वाली भारतीय सैन्य अकादमी (IMA) कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The IMA is in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय सैन्य अकादमी देहरादून, उत्तराखंड में है।

questions.text: Who wrote India's national song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय गीत "वंदे मातरम्" किसने लिखा?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram". Tagore wrote the national anthem "Jana Gana Mana".
questions.explanationHi: "वंदे मातरम्" बंकिम चंद्र चटर्जी ने लिखा। राष्ट्रगान "जन गण मन" टैगोर ने लिखा।

questions.text: Teachers' Day is celebrated in India on:
questions.textHi: भारत में शिक्षक दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Teachers' Day is on 5 September, the birthday of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan.
questions.explanationHi: शिक्षक दिवस 5 सितंबर को डॉ. सर्वपल्ली राधाकृष्णन के जन्मदिन पर मनाया जाता है।

questions.text: In which event did Neeraj Chopra win a gold medal for India at the Tokyo Olympics (held in 2021)?
questions.textHi: टोक्यो ओलंपिक (2021 में आयोजित) में नीरज चोपड़ा ने किस स्पर्धा में भारत के लिए स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra won gold in the men's javelin throw at Tokyo in 2021.
questions.explanationHi: नीरज चोपड़ा ने 2021 में टोक्यो में पुरुषों की भाला फेंक में स्वर्ण जीता।

questions.text: The famous Sun Temple of Konark is in which state?
questions.textHi: कोणार्क का प्रसिद्ध सूर्य मंदिर किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: The Konark Sun Temple, shaped like a giant chariot, is in Odisha.
questions.explanationHi: विशाल रथ के आकार का कोणार्क सूर्य मंदिर ओडिशा में है।

questions.text: Which is the largest ocean in the world?
questions.textHi: विश्व का सबसे बड़ा महासागर कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.
questions.explanationHi: प्रशांत महासागर सबसे बड़ा और सबसे गहरा महासागर है।
